task.description: fn:git-setup for run_id=WF03-gh445-flaky-pd07-20260805, branch feature/WF03-gh445-flaky-pd07-20260805. Then diagnose and fix GH #445 / ISS-0141 (order-dependent flaky tests in tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig).
acceptance_criteria: root cause of order-dependent flakiness identified
zig build test passes deterministically across 5 consecutive runs with different seeds

result.summary: Root-caused and fixed GH #445 / ISS-0141. The original --seed/order-dependent hypothesis was incorrect (Zig's std.testing runner does not reorder test blocks on --seed). Actual root cause: every TC-PD-07-* fixture in tests/unit/definition_retrieval_test.zig used a hardcoded literal name/version against the shared BPM_TEST_DB_URL. Reproduced deterministically by launching 3-5 truly parallel `zig build test-bpm-main` OS processes: the second process's create() INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING no-ops on the uq_definition_tenant_version unique constraint (DuplicateNameVersion), and activate()'s deprecate step (scoped only by name, not row id) lets one process deprecate a different process's freshly-activated row before that process's own getActiveByName() reads it back (DefinitionNotFound) -- reproducing both symptoms in the original report exactly. Fixed by adding a uniqueName() helper (fresh UUID v4 via bpm.api_trace.generateUuidV4) applied to every fixture name. Verified with 6 consecutive full `zig build test` runs (617/701 passing, 0 failures) plus 8 truly-concurrent zig build test-bpm-main invocations (3-way + 5-way parallel), all clean post-fix vs reliable failures pre-fix under identical 3-way parallel launch.
result.next_action: Docs/changelog follow-up completed via PR #452 (feature/WF03-gh445-flaky-pd07-docs-20260805). GH #445 closed. No further action -- run complete.
